About Hotel Shyam

Where Tradition Meets Taste!

Serving authentic flavors since 1972

Our Story

Experience the royal flavors of authentic Indian cuisine at Hotel Shyam, a beloved culinary destination since 1972. We specialize in Rajasthani, Mughlai & Punjabi dishes, crafted with traditional recipes passed down through generations and prepared with the finest ingredients.

  • 50+ years of culinary excellence
  • Hygienic kitchen & cozy ambiance
  • Perfect blend of taste & affordability
  • Family-friendly dining experience
  • Expert chefs with decades of experience
  • Authentic recipes unchanged for generations
